podcast.title: Collaborations and Friendship
podcast.body: James McCartney has appeared on albums by both his father, Paul McCartney, and his mother, Linda McCartney. He became friends with other Beatles offspring—Danny Harrison, Zach Starkey, and Sean Lennon—and they entertained the idea of forming a band, though it didn't come to fruition. "He's appeared on albums by both Paul and Linda and has several records of his own. He eventually became friends with Danny Harrison, son of George, Zach Starky, son of Ringo, and Sean Lennon, son of John. They floored with the idea of forming their own band. Imagine that, but nothing ever came of it."
